verdict.rationale: Browserbase docs mention that downloaded files (PDFs, spreadsheets) can be retrieved via the Downloads API and processed during an agent run, which implies text/content extraction without self-hosting, but this is a single thin doc line with no mention of Word or PowerPoint formats, no detail on extraction fidelity, and no dedicated extraction API. missing for 10: explicit support for Word/PowerPoint formats, documented extraction API/output format, and independent evidence of extraction quality.
